_comment_paths: Directorios de trabajo (IMPORTANTE para gestión de discos)
_comment_paths_explanation: null = usa carpeta del video. Ejemplos: 'E:\highlights', 'D:\temp'
_comment_detection_mode: Detection modes: 'fast' (templates+audio only), 'hybrid' (fast+LLM validation), 'llm_only' (full LLM analysis)
_comment_game: Game-specific settings - set to 'lol' for League of Legends, 'generic' for other games
_comment_templates: Template matching settings (LoL Victory/Defeat screens, etc.)
_comment_regions: Template regions in NORMALIZED coordinates (0-1 scale, resolution-agnostic)
_comment_regions_explanation: Format: [x_norm, y_norm, width_norm, height_norm] where 0.5 = 50% of screen width/height
